visual_grammar.medium_handling: Documentary still / archival-performance image translated into the deck's matte editorial print language: film grain, contact-sheet texture, restrained spot color, crop marks, and occasional hand annotation. The subject is David Byrne at the age/stage appropriate to the named song or era rather than a generic symbolic stand-in.
visual_grammar.composition: A chronological documentary arc. Early trumps favor cool, static, framed, observed compositions; middle trumps destabilize the frame through system, travel, rupture, and collaboration; late trumps grow warmer, closer, more fluid, civic, and bodily. Symbolic imagery may enter, but it should feel discovered within documentary footage rather than replacing the human subject.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Photographic/film edges, archival crop or frame boundaries, grain, modest motion blur, double exposure, projection, reflection, and hand-marked editorial traces; avoid fantasy illustration outlines.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Era-responsive documentary contrast: early cool neutrals and hard black/white separation gradually admit warmer skin, richer stage color, daylight, and collective luminous fields without flattening every decade into one filter.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Age- and era-appropriate documentary camera language: early wary close/medium observation, increasingly mobile performance/street/civic framing, ending among bodies rather than outside them. Byrne remains human-scale even when the venue becomes enormous.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Specificity belongs in recognizable age, hair, wardrobe, suit silhouette, instrument/performance context, room/venue, gesture, and archival texture. Symbolic overlays stay secondary to the credible documentary subject.
visual_grammar.finish: A coherent documentary made across five decades: historically shifting footage held together by one tactile editorial/archival treatment and a visible progression from nervous self-observation toward embodied communion.
avoid: generic anonymous protagonist standing in for Byrne
one identical age or wardrobe across all majors
literal music-video recreation as the only idea
symbolic surrealism that erases documentary specificity

factorization.gloss: Zero — before the performance has acquired a stable persona or system: arrival with no fixed role yet, the open condition from which the Byrnian journey can begin.
factorization.visual_logic: Leave generous documentary ground around an awkward arriving figure. No mature system or performative identity should yet organize the frame; the image is possibility before self-design.

factorization.gloss: One — the isolated operator turned inward: the self observing itself and discovering the unnerving fact of its own voice. The journey's first unit is the watcher switching on.
factorization.visual_logic: Use one figure and one recursive/reflected source of attention. A single gaze, mirror, or monitoring loop should activate the whole frame without multiplying into a social system.

factorization.gloss: Two — an irreducible relation between person and system: self and government, citizen and structure. Neither term explains the other away; the card begins the deck's lifelong argument with frameworks.
factorization.visual_logic: Build one clear dyad—person/system, house/city, private/public—across an active interval. The relation must be indispensable: remove either pole and the composition collapses.

factorization.gloss: Three — an irreducible vantage: observer, observed world, and the distance between them. The Big Country's detachment is not assembled from smaller lessons; it is a new three-term way of seeing.
factorization.visual_logic: Use a triadic geometry of observer, landscape/system, and separating frame or distance—window, airplane, map, horizon—so detachment itself becomes the third formal term.

factorization.gloss: Two squared — the person/system relation of Government hardened into a total four-corner emergency frame. Life During Wartime is structure doubled until every route, object, and habit is organized by survival.
factorization.visual_logic: Square the dyad into repeated checkpoints, routes, rooms, or urgent grid cells. The system should feel doubled and totalized: fourfold order under pressure rather than one simple opposition.

factorization.gloss: Five — an irreducible perfect stasis: Heaven simply is, beautiful and complete and therefore terrifying. Its stillness cannot be explained as a compromise among earlier structures.
factorization.visual_logic: Give the image one fixed, immaculate center or loop with almost no formal escape. Perfection should feel singular, self-sufficient, and visually resistant to further decomposition.

factorization.gloss: Two times three — system relation meets detached pattern-recognition: the house (2) is seen through the observer's triadic distance (3) and begins to breathe. Architecture acquires rhythm; structure discovers the body.
factorization.visual_logic: Interlock an orthogonal dyadic/grid structure with a three-direction or three-phase motion pattern. The same architecture must read simultaneously as measured system and animated rhythm.

factorization.gloss: Seven — irreducible recognition: the instant 'How did I get here?' cannot be assembled gradually. It arrives whole, splitting ordinary life with one undivided fact of self-awareness.
factorization.visual_logic: Organize around one uncompromising recognition axis—mirror, waterline, gaze, or doubled pose. Everything else should support the single shock of seeing oneself.

factorization.gloss: Two cubed — the system/relation recursively repeated until road, routine, and collective movement become a world in themselves. Road to Nowhere turns repetition from trap into shared motion.
factorization.visual_logic: Use nested or repeated paired route rhythms at several scales—people/road, step/step, here/there—so recursive structure becomes joyful procession rather than static grid.

factorization.gloss: Three squared — the detached pattern-maker turns back on its own pattern until the frame becomes the event. Burning Down the House is observation doubled into transformation: perspective catches fire and remakes what contained it.
factorization.visual_logic: Nest or echo a triadic arrangement inside another triad, then visibly destabilize the enclosing frame. Repetition should cause the structure to ignite, rupture, or become performance.

factorization.gloss: Two times five — the person/system relation meets Heaven's indivisible perfection and becomes something livable: home is a chosen structure whose still center is another person, not an abstract ideal.
factorization.visual_logic: Place a calm singular domestic center inside a clear relational enclosure: two people or self/place held around one unforced focal stillness. Structure serves intimacy rather than containing it.

factorization.gloss: Eleven — an irreducible ecological inversion: the shopping mall is flowers now, and the whole value system flips in one clean imaginative act. It is a new proposition, not the sum of earlier comforts.
factorization.visual_logic: Use one decisive before/after or civilization/nature inversion that reads instantly across the whole frame. Avoid many incremental transitions; the formal idea should arrive whole.

factorization.gloss: Four times three — the totalized structure of Wartime (4) is seen through the Big Country's detached triadic vantage (3), and the familiar system reveals a misalignment. Something ain't right because the map and the lived frame no longer close.
factorization.visual_logic: Build a familiar four-part/grid world and introduce a three-part observational offset that cannot align with it. Small registration drift, wrong shadow, or mismatched perspective should make systemic wrongness formally legible.

factorization.gloss: Thirteen — irreducible inner conflict: the Civil Wars name a split that cannot be reduced to external factions because the battlefield is the self. The contradiction stands whole.
factorization.visual_logic: Use one figure divided by a single strong seam, shadow, double exposure, or opposed bodily vector. Keep the conflict formally singular rather than multiplying it into many enemies.

factorization.gloss: Two times seven — the constructed self/system relation (2) passes through Once in a Lifetime's recognition (7): the self-made man sees the blueprint as his own doing and can no longer pretend the design came from elsewhere.
factorization.visual_logic: Intersect a designed grid/blueprint with one recognition axis such as mirror, gaze, or tracing hand. The figure should occupy both sides of creator/created relation at once.

factorization.gloss: Three times five — detached perspective (3) meets Heaven's indivisible ideal (5) and yields tenderness toward what does not fit perfection. Broken Things becomes a way of seeing damage without demanding its erasure.
factorization.visual_logic: Arrange several broken or incomplete parts through a calm triadic relation around one still interval of value. The image should find compositional wholeness without pretending the fragments are unbroken.

factorization.gloss: Two to the fourth — the system relation recursively squared until the domestic frame cannot contain itself. Tiny Apocalypse is structure repeated inward at personal scale until the room becomes its own catastrophe.
factorization.visual_logic: Nest four-square/domestic frames recursively—room within frame within routine—then let the repeated enclosure fail from inside. Collapse should arise from too much internalized structure, not an external meteor.

factorization.gloss: Seventeen — irreducible hope: One Fine Day is a future-facing yes that appears after collapse without needing proof from the broken systems behind it.
factorization.visual_logic: Hold one clear horizon, opening, or small future-oriented light against damaged ground. The hopeful proposition should remain formally singular and impossible to subdivide.

factorization.gloss: Two times nine — relationship/system (2) passes through Burning Down the House's transformed perspective (9): Lazarus returns because collaboration and re-seeing rebuild what destruction opened.
factorization.visual_logic: Stage a clear before/after dyad inside a recursively transformed field: doubled body or prone/upright relation surrounded by echoes of the prior broken frame now reorganizing into return.

factorization.gloss: Nineteen — irreducible embodied declaration: 'I dance like this' does not require a system, explanation, or correct form. The body itself becomes the atomic statement.
factorization.visual_logic: Let one unmistakable body-in-motion proposition organize the frame without explanatory diagram or detached observer. The gesture should feel complete because it is inhabited, not because it is analyzed.

factorization.gloss: Four times five — the survival structure of Wartime (4) meets Heaven's singular ideal (5), but at human scale: ordinary life itself becomes miraculous when the frame is stable enough to notice its impossible center.
factorization.visual_logic: Use an ordinary four-square domestic/civic field organized around one small luminous or astonishing everyday center. Wonder should arise inside structure, not escape into spectacle.

factorization.gloss: Three times seven — the detached three-term gaze of The Big Country passes through Once in a Lifetime's recognition: observer, world, and distance resolve when the watcher finally enters the crowd. Everybody Laughs completes the journey by making perception participatory.
factorization.visual_logic: Layer foreground/middle/background or observer/world/frame as a triad, then drive one recognition/participation vector through all three so the former observer becomes visibly continuous with collective joy.
